# ⛏️ VaultCraft SMP

> A Minecraft survival multiplayer experience built around
> community, exploration, and progression.

---

## 🌍 About the Server

**VaultCraft SMP** is a community-driven survival multiplayer server where
players come together to build, explore, and thrive. Whether you're a
seasoned veteran or a fresh survivor, VaultCraft offers a welcoming and
active community with a focus on vanilla-style survival enhanced by
carefully chosen plugins for quality of life and fair play.

No pay-to-win. No unfair advantages. Just pure survival with friends.

---

## ✅ What We Offer

- 🌿 **Survival-focused** — Vanilla-style gameplay with QoL improvements
- 💬 **Discord Integration** — Real-time server chat bridged to Discord
- 🛡️ **Anti-cheat & Alt Detection** — Fair play enforced for everyone
- 📢 **Active Staff** — Responsive team keeping the server clean and fun
- 🗺️ **24/7 Uptime** — Always online, always ready
- 🔒 **Secure Authentication** — Your account, protected

---

## 📋 Server Rules (Summary)

1. Respect all players — no harassment or hate speech
3. No cheating, hacking, or use of unfair mods
4. No alternate accounts to bypass bans
5. Keep chat clean and friendly
6. Follow staff instructions at all times

*Full rules available in our Discord.*
